offers_products.reason: Sells expedition cruises and guided trips; no goods are among its main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Expedition cruises and land-based guided travel (Natural Habitat, DuVine, Classic Journeys) are travel services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Travelers and families book expedition cruises, solo and family offers, via expedition specialists.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Main buyers are individual travelers; ship charters are offered but are a minor line.

recurring_revenue.reason: Each expedition is a one-off booking; guests may return, but revenue is trip-by-trip.

cyclical_demand.reason: Luxury adventure cruises are discretionary travel that customers can easily postpone or cancel in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Multi-day luxury expedition voyages are costly, infrequent purchases, booked well in advance.

people_delivered.reason: Value rests on its expedition ships and destinations as well as guides; the fleet carries the service.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual travelers and households, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: It owns and operates a fleet of expedition ships such as National Geographic Endurance, which needs ongoing capital.

notes: Ship charters exist but look minor; land-based travel brands are the smaller segment.
